description: ML4Floods is SpaceML and collaborators' Python software for training and applying satellite-based flood-mapping models. Its FloodMapper workflows prepare Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery, distinguish cloud and water, evaluate predictions and produce vectorised maps. Inputs include imagery, labelled training examples, model configuration and an area and period; outputs include trained models, segmentation masks and flood polygons. Geographic coverage is configurable and depends on satellite availability. Software source is free under LGPL-3.0, while the linked WorldFloods v2 dataset and trained models use CC-BY-NC-4.0 terms. A limitation is that clouds, shadows and sensor differences affect mapped extent, and the pipeline does not itself predict hydraulic depth. Training and deployment need separate computing and data services. ML4Floods can provide event observations for evaluating flood-infrastructure simulations such as Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The README documents the pipeline and cites the 2023 flood-mapping paper. No imagery, weights or training data were downloaded.
